summary: 33 units reviewed: 14 fix, 19 ok. 2 error, 22 minor, all with machine patches; no regrouping suggested. Tokens, sandhi, cases, roots and compound types are sound throughout; Hindi has no Latin letters or brackets. Draft doubts judged: 8.3.1 a-(vidyā-vinaya) is right (avidyā+avinaya would need an elided a- the e-text does not show); 8.3.7 kṣaya-nimittam adverbial 'on account of decline' accepted, medium confidence honest; 8.3.9 avajñā-vadha better read 'destruction of contempt' (counterpart of paribhava in 8.3.15) — patched, but a person may want to confirm against Kangle; 8.3.11 sampriya-bhāva 'being well-loved' kept, 'to all' removed; 8.3.14 śatru-vedana 'acquisition of enemies' (√vid 'find') accepted; 8.3.25 paruṣa-mukta accepted, 'in retaliation' made literal. Errors: 8.3.11 Hindi 'सान्त्वना' (consolation) for sāntva and added 'से...प्राप्त होते हैं'; 8.3.20 English 'attachment' for saṃyoga (confused with āsaṅga of 8.3.21). Consistency with 8.1 restored: 'say the Parasharas' / 'ऐसा पाराशर कहते हैं', spelling 'Vishalaksha' settled. GLOSSARY extended: vyasana (calamity; 'vice' for the king's personal vyasanas of 8.3), kopa/kāma, garīyān, vāk-/daṇḍa-pāruṣya and artha-dūṣaṇa (with the Book 3 offence sense noted), teacher names, the 'No, says X' formula.
